name: github-actions-docs
title: GitHub Actions Docs
description: Look up GitHub Actions documentation and patterns while building workflows.
whenToUse: Use when writing or updating a GitHub Actions workflow and you need documentation or examples for its syntax and behavior.

name: git-commit
title: Git Commit
description: Draft clear, conventional commit messages from the current repository changes.
whenToUse: Use when changes are ready to commit and you want help turning the diff into a clear, conventional commit message.

name: azure-deployment-preflight
title: Azure Deployment Preflight
description: Validate Bicep deployments before they run: template checks, what-if previews and permission checks for az and azd.
whenToUse: Use before deploying Azure infrastructure with Bicep through az or azd, when you need template validation, a what-if preview, or permission checks.

name: documentation-writer
title: Documentation Writer
description: Turn code and rough notes into practical documentation for engineers.
whenToUse: Use when code or rough engineering notes need to become readable documentation that helps other engineers understand or use the project.
